name: Meursault

limits: D Aligote, Melon, Sacy and Cesar together: at most 10%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Pinot Gris sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

keyfacts: Meursault is a Côte de Beaune commune in Burgundy, and white wine from Chardonnay makes up around 98% of production.
There are no Grand Cru vineyards within Meursault, but there are several Premier Cru vineyards.
White Meursault typically shows clear oak influence and malolactic fermentation, which leads to descriptions such as buttery.
Premier Cru climats lie in two groups, north of the village bordering Volnay and a larger group to the south toward Puligny-Montrachet and Blagny.

blurb.text: A Côte de Beaune appellation, about 98% white from Chardonnay, with a little red from Pinot Noir. It has no Grand Cru vineyards but several highly regarded Premier Cru vineyards.
